pinyin: gǒu ná hào zi —— duō guǎn xián shì
literal: dog · catch · rat — too much · meddle · idle · business
natural: a dog chasing rats

meaning.en: A dog catching rats (a cat's job); meddling in matters that are none of one's business.
meaning.zh: 狗去抓老鼠，那是猫的事；比喻管不该管的闲事。

equivalents: stick one's nose into other people's business

examples.zh: 你这是狗拿耗子，别人家的事少操心。
examples.en: You're poking your nose in; stop worrying about other people's affairs.

examples.zh: 我知道这像狗拿耗子，但还是想提醒你一句。
examples.en: I know it's none of my business, but I still want to warn you.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous. Often used self-deprecatingly as a preface to unsolicited advice.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。常用来自嘲，作为多嘴提醒别人之前的开场白。

text: 猪八戒照镜子——里外不是人
pinyin: zhū bā jiè zhào jìng zi —— lǐ wài bù shì rén
literal: Zhu Bajie · look into · mirror — inside · outside · not · person
natural: Pigsy looks in the mirror and sees no human

meaning.en: Pigsy looking in a mirror sees neither a man nor a pig; being blamed from every side whatever one does.
meaning.zh: 猪八戒照镜子，里外都不像人；比喻两头不讨好，怎么做都落埋怨。

equivalents: damned if you do, damned if you don't
caught between a rock and a hard place

examples.zh: 夹在婆婆和妻子之间，他真是猪八戒照镜子。
examples.en: Caught between his mother and his wife, he can't win either way.

examples.zh: 当中间人就是猪八戒照镜子，两边都怪你。
examples.en: Being the go-between is a thankless job; both sides blame you.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous. Pigsy is the half-pig companion in 《西游记》; 'not a person' also means 'in the wrong with everyone'.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。猪八戒是《西游记》中半人半猪的角色；“不是人”也含“落不是”之意。

pinyin: ní pú sà guò jiāng —— zì shēn nán bǎo
literal: clay · Bodhisattva · cross · river — oneself · body · hard · protect
natural: a clay Buddha crossing a river

meaning.en: A clay Buddha crossing a river dissolves; someone in so much trouble that they cannot even protect themselves, let alone help others.
meaning.zh: 泥塑的菩萨过河会化掉；比喻自己都保不住，更没法帮别人。

equivalents: in no position to help anyone
can barely keep one's own head above water

examples.zh: 公司都快倒闭了，我现在是泥菩萨过江，帮不了你。
examples.en: The company is about to fold; I can barely look after myself, let alone help you.

examples.zh: 他自己也泥菩萨过江，你别指望他了。
examples.en: He's in deep trouble himself, so don't count on him.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。

text: 黄鼠狼给鸡拜年——没安好心
pinyin: huáng shǔ láng gěi jī bài nián —— méi ān hǎo xīn
variants: 黄鼠狼给鸡拜年——不怀好意
literal: weasel · give · chicken · New Year greetings — not · harbour · good · heart
natural: a weasel pays New Year calls on the chickens

meaning.en: A weasel wishing the hens a happy New Year; someone who is nice to you but has bad intentions.
meaning.zh: 黄鼠狼向鸡拜年，不会有好事；比喻表面殷勤，实则不怀好意。

examples.zh: 他突然对你这么热情，不是黄鼠狼给鸡拜年吗？
examples.en: He's suddenly so friendly with you; isn't that a weasel greeting the hens?

examples.zh: 推销员送来的礼物，多半是黄鼠狼给鸡拜年。
examples.en: A gift from a salesman usually comes with strings attached.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous. Weasels (黄鼠狼) are traditionally believed to prey on chickens.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。传统上认为黄鼠狼会偷吃鸡。

pinyin: xiǎo cōng bàn dòu fu —— yī qīng èr bái
literal: scallion · mix · tofu — one · green/clear · two · white
natural: scallion and tofu: one green, two white

meaning.en: Spring onion mixed with tofu is one green and two white; perfectly clear, or above reproach.
meaning.zh: 小葱是青的，豆腐是白的；比喻清清楚楚，或为人清白。

examples.zh: 这笔账小葱拌豆腐，一清二白，不怕查。
examples.en: These accounts are crystal clear; we have nothing to fear from an audit.

examples.zh: 他当了一辈子官，小葱拌豆腐，清清白白。
examples.en: He served as an official all his life and kept entirely clean hands.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous. A pun: 青 (green) and 清 (clear) sound the same, hence 一清二白 also reads as 'one green, two white'.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。谐音双关：“青”与“清”同音，故“一清二白”又指一青二白。

pinyin: gǎn miàn zhàng chuī huǒ —— yī qiào bù tōng
variants: 实心竹子吹火——一窍不通
literal: rolling pin · blow · fire — one · hole · not · pass through
natural: blowing on a fire through a rolling pin

meaning.en: Trying to blow on a fire through a solid rolling pin, which has no hole; knowing nothing at all about a subject.
meaning.zh: 擀面杖是实心的，没有孔，吹不了火；比喻对某事一点儿也不懂。

examples.zh: 我对电脑是擀面杖吹火，一窍不通。
examples.en: I'm completely clueless about computers.

examples.zh: 他谈起股票来头头是道，可我是擀面杖吹火。
examples.en: He talks about shares fluently, but I don't have a clue.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous. Plays on 窍, 'hole' and also 'insight'.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。“窍”既指孔洞，也指领悟的门道。

text: 癞蛤蟆想吃天鹅肉——痴心妄想
pinyin: lài há ma xiǎng chī tiān é ròu —— chī xīn wàng xiǎng
variants: 癞蛤蟆想吃天鹅肉——白日做梦
literal: scabby · toad · want · eat · swan · meat — foolish · heart · rash · think
natural: a toad longs to eat swan

meaning.en: A toad longing to eat swan; an ugly or lowly person hoping for something far above their station.
meaning.zh: 癞蛤蟆想吃天鹅肉；比喻不自量力，妄想得到高不可攀的东西。

equivalents: a toad hankering after a swan

examples.zh: 他想追校花？癞蛤蟆想吃天鹅肉！
examples.en: He wants to date the campus beauty? Dream on!

examples.zh: 别听他的，那是癞蛤蟆想吃天鹅肉的事。
examples.en: Don't listen to him; it's a pipe dream.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous. Can sound insulting when aimed at a person's looks or status; often used mockingly of romantic hopes.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。用于别人的相貌或身份时带贬损意味，多用来嘲讽对感情的妄想。

pinyin: jī dàn pèng shí tou —— zì bù liàng lì
literal: egg · hit · stone — self · not · weigh · strength
natural: an egg against a rock

meaning.en: An egg knocked against a rock breaks; taking on an opponent far stronger than oneself.
meaning.zh: 鸡蛋碰石头，碰碎的是鸡蛋；比喻不估量自己的力量，与强者硬拼。

equivalents: throw an egg at a rock
pit oneself against a far stronger foe

examples.zh: 小公司跟巨头打价格战，等于鸡蛋碰石头。
examples.en: A small firm starting a price war with a giant is like an egg against a rock.

examples.zh: 别鸡蛋碰石头了，认输吧。
examples.en: Stop banging your head against a wall and admit defeat.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。

pinyin: jiāng tài gōng diào yú —— yuàn zhě shàng gōu
literal: Jiang Taigong · fish — willing · person · take · hook
natural: Jiang Taigong fishing: those who are willing take the hook

meaning.en: Jiang Taigong fished with a straight, baitless hook; whoever wishes to take part does so of their own free will.
meaning.zh: 姜太公钓鱼不用饵，愿意的自己上钩；比喻心甘情愿地上当或参与。

equivalents: it's up to you; no pressure
those who want to may join in

examples.zh: 这个活动姜太公钓鱼，愿者上钩，不强求。
examples.en: Join this activity if you like; there's no pressure.

examples.zh: 我这是姜太公钓鱼，你不愿意就算了。
examples.en: Take it or leave it; I won't force you.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous. Often said of a lure that nobody is forced to accept. Source: the legend of Jiang Ziya fishing by the Wei river before King Wen of Zhou found him.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。常指无人强迫的诱饵。典出姜子牙在渭水垂钓，等周文王来访的传说。

text: 周瑜打黄盖——一个愿打，一个愿挨
pinyin: zhōu yú dǎ huáng gài —— yī gè yuàn dǎ, yī gè yuàn ái
literal: Zhou Yu · beat · Huang Gai — one · willing · beat, one · willing · endure
natural: Zhou Yu beats Huang Gai: one willing to strike, one willing to be struck

meaning.en: Zhou Yu flogs Huang Gai as part of a ruse; both parties consent, so nobody else has any right to object.
meaning.zh: 周瑜打黄盖是两人商量好的苦肉计；比喻双方心甘情愿，别人无权干涉。

equivalents: it takes two to tango; both are willing
a private arrangement between consenting parties

examples.zh: 他愿意出钱，她愿意收，周瑜打黄盖，你管得着吗？
examples.en: He's willing to pay and she's willing to accept; it's no business of yours.

examples.zh: 这是周瑜打黄盖，咱们外人别插嘴。
examples.en: It's a deal between two willing parties; let's not interfere.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous. Refers to the 'self-inflicted injury' ruse before the Battle of Red Cliffs in 《三国演义》.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。典出《三国演义》赤壁之战前的“苦肉计”。

pinyin: xiā zi diǎn dēng —— bái fèi là
literal: blind person · light · lamp — in vain · waste · wax
natural: a blind man lights a lamp

meaning.en: A blind person lighting a candle gains nothing from it; wasted effort and resources.
meaning.zh: 瞎子点灯用不上，蜡烛白白浪费；比喻做了没有用的事，白费力气。

equivalents: a waste of time and money

examples.zh: 这些宣传没人看，简直瞎子点灯，白费蜡。
examples.en: Nobody reads this publicity; it's a complete waste.

examples.zh: 你跟他讲道理，那是瞎子点灯。
examples.en: Reasoning with him is wasted effort.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous. The word 瞎子 ('blind person') may be considered rude; the saying is more often used in jest than about real persons.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。“瞎子”一词略显不敬，多作调侃，不用于指真正的盲人。

pinyin: kǒng fū zǐ bān jiā —— jìng shì shū
literal: Confucius · move house — all · be · books (lose)
natural: Confucius moves house: nothing but books

meaning.en: When Confucius moves house, all he owns is books; a pun on 书 (books) and 输 (lose), used for repeated losing at games or contests.
meaning.zh: 孔夫子搬家，全是书；“书”谐“输”，比喻老是输。

examples.zh: 今天打牌孔夫子搬家，一把都没赢。
examples.en: I lost every hand at cards today.

examples.zh: 咱们队连续输了五场，真是孔夫子搬家。
examples.en: Our team has lost five in a row.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous. A pun: 书 (shū, books) sounds like 输 (shū, lose), so the punchline means 'always losing'.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。谐音双关：“书”与“输”同音，后半句暗指“总是输”。

pinyin: qí lǘ kàn chàng běn —— zǒu zhe qiáo
literal: ride · donkey · read · libretto — walk · -ing · look
natural: reading a libretto on a donkey: look as we go

meaning.en: Reading a song book while riding a donkey, one reads as one goes; let's wait and see how things turn out.
meaning.zh: 骑在驴上看唱本，边走边看；比喻等着看结果，走着瞧。

examples.zh: 你别得意，骑驴看唱本，走着瞧！
examples.en: Don't get smug; we'll see who has the last laugh.

examples.zh: 事情会怎样，骑驴看唱本吧。
examples.en: How it turns out, we'll see as we go.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous. Often a mild threat or a challenge, said with a smile or a glare.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。常带半开玩笑或挑战的语气。

pinyin: wáng bā chī chèng tuó —— tiě le xīn
literal: turtle · eat · steelyard weight — iron · -ed · heart
natural: a turtle swallows a weight: heart of iron

meaning.en: A turtle that has swallowed an iron weight; someone absolutely determined, not to be moved.
meaning.zh: 王八吃了铁秤砣，肚子里硬邦邦；比喻下定决心，怎么劝也不改变。

examples.zh: 他这回王八吃秤砣，铁了心要辞职。
examples.en: This time he's made up his mind and will resign, come what may.

examples.zh: 劝也没用，她王八吃秤砣了。
examples.en: It's no use persuading her; she's set on it.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous. 王八 is a crude word for turtle, so keep it for informal talk; 铁了心 alone is fully standard.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。“王八”略粗俗，仅限随意交谈；单说“铁了心”则很规范。

pinyin: tiě gōng jī —— yī máo bù bá
literal: iron · rooster — one · feather · not · pluck
natural: an iron rooster: not one feather to be plucked

meaning.en: An iron cockerel has no feathers to pluck; a miser who will not part with a penny.
meaning.zh: 铁铸的公鸡拔不下一根毛；比喻非常吝啬，一分钱也不肯出。

examples.zh: 他是出了名的铁公鸡，请客从来不掏钱。
examples.en: He's a notorious skinflint who never pays for anyone.

examples.zh: 别指望铁公鸡捐款。
examples.en: Don't expect a miser to donate.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous. Also used on its own as a noun: 他是个铁公鸡 ('he's a miser').
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。也可单独作名词用：“他是个铁公鸡”。

text: 关公面前耍大刀——自不量力
pinyin: guān gōng miàn qián shuǎ dà dāo —— zì bù liàng lì
variants: 鲁班门前耍大斧——不自量力
literal: Guan Gong · in front of · play · big · sword — self · not · weigh · strength
natural: showing off a halberd in front of Guan Yu

meaning.en: Brandishing a sword in front of the master swordsman Guan Yu; showing off one's modest skill before a real expert.
meaning.zh: 在关羽面前舞大刀；比喻在行家面前卖弄本领，不自量力。

equivalents: teach one's grandmother to suck eggs
show off in front of an expert

examples.zh: 在专业设计师面前谈审美，不是关公面前耍大刀吗？
examples.en: Lecturing a professional designer on taste is like teaching your grandmother to suck eggs.

examples.zh: 我这点厨艺在大厨面前就是关公面前耍大刀。
examples.en: My cooking is nothing before a real chef.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous. Guan Gong (Guan Yu) was famed for his halberd. The idiom 班门弄斧 carries the same meaning.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。关公（关羽）以大刀著称。成语“班门弄斧”意思相同。

pinyin: liú bèi shuāi hái zi —— shōu mǎi rén xīn
literal: Liu Bei · throw down · child — buy · win over · people's · hearts
natural: Liu Bei throws his son to the ground

meaning.en: Liu Bei flung his infant son to the ground, saying he nearly lost a general for him; winning people's loyalty by a gesture.
meaning.zh: 刘备把儿子阿斗摔在地上，说为你差点损失一员大将；比喻用手段笼络人心。

equivalents: win people over with a show of affection

examples.zh: 领导给员工发红包，别人说他是刘备摔孩子。
examples.en: When the boss handed out red envelopes, people said he was just buying loyalty.

examples.zh: 她这么热情，是不是刘备摔孩子？
examples.en: Is she so friendly just to win us over?

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous. Based on the scene at Changban in 《三国演义》, where Zhao Yun rescues the infant Adou.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。出自《三国演义》长坂坡一节，赵云救出幼主阿斗。

pinyin: mǎ wěi chuān dòu fu —— tí bù qǐ lái
variants: 马尾巴提豆腐——提不起来
literal: horse · tail · thread through · tofu — lift · not · up
natural: threading tofu on a horse's tail

meaning.en: Horsehair is too fine to lift tofu; something or someone not worth mentioning, or hopeless.
meaning.zh: 马尾太细，穿不起豆腐；比喻不值一提，或人不中用，扶不起来。

examples.zh: 这点小成绩，马尾穿豆腐，提不起来。
examples.en: Such a small achievement isn't worth mentioning.

examples.zh: 让他当领导，真是马尾穿豆腐。
examples.en: Putting him in charge is hopeless.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous. 提 also means 'to mention', so it can mean 'not worth mentioning'.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。“提”还有“提及”之意，所以也可指“不值一提”。

text: 打肿脸充胖子——死要面子活受罪
pinyin: dǎ zhǒng liǎn chōng pàng zi —— sǐ yào miàn zi huó shòu zuì
literal: beat · swollen · face · pass for · fat person — die · want · face · alive · suffer · ordeal
natural: slap one's face red to look plump

meaning.en: Slapping one's face to make it look plump; keeping up appearances at one's own expense.
meaning.zh: 把脸打肿装作胖子；比喻为了面子硬撑，结果自己吃苦。

equivalents: keep up appearances at all costs
put on a show beyond one's means

examples.zh: 他借钱买名牌，纯粹是打肿脸充胖子。
examples.en: He borrowed money to buy designer labels, just to keep up appearances.

examples.zh: 没钱就别打肿脸充胖子了。
examples.en: Don't pretend you're rich if you aren't.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous. Often shortened to 打肿脸充胖子; the second half spells out the moral.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。常只说“打肿脸充胖子”；后半句直接点明含义。

text: 死猪不怕开水烫——满不在乎
pinyin: sǐ zhū bù pà kāi shuǐ tàng —— mǎn bù zài hū
literal: dead · pig · not · fear · boiling · water · scald — fully · not · care
natural: a dead pig fears no boiling water

meaning.en: A dead pig is not afraid of being scalded; someone who has lost everything or is beyond caring and cannot be threatened.
meaning.zh: 死猪不怕被开水烫；比喻处境已经最糟，无所畏惧、不在乎。

examples.zh: 他欠了一屁股债，现在死猪不怕开水烫。
examples.en: He's up to his neck in debt and is past caring.

examples.zh: 对付这种死猪不怕开水烫的人，真没办法。
examples.en: There's nothing to be done with someone so thick-skinned.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous. Usually disapproving: someone who shrugs off criticism or punishment.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。多含贬义，指对批评或处罚毫不在乎的人。

pinyin: ròu bāo zi dǎ gǒu —— yǒu qù wú huí
literal: meat · bun · hit · dog — have · go · no · return
natural: throwing a meat bun at a dog

meaning.en: Throwing a meat bun at a dog, which will run off with it; something lent or invested that never comes back.
meaning.zh: 用肉包子打狗，包子有去无回；比喻送出去的东西再也要不回来。

examples.zh: 借给他的钱就像肉包子打狗，有去无回。
examples.en: The money I lent him has gone for good.

examples.zh: 这笔投资可别成了肉包子打狗。
examples.en: Let's hope this investment doesn't vanish without a trace.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。

pinyin: māo kū lǎo shǔ —— jiǎ cí bēi
literal: cat · weep · mouse — false · mercy · compassion
natural: a cat weeps over a mouse

meaning.en: A cat shedding tears over a mouse it has killed; pretended sympathy from the one who caused the harm.
meaning.zh: 猫吃了老鼠还装作哭泣；比喻假装同情，实则不怀好意。

examples.zh: 他把人家搞垮了，现在又来慰问，这是猫哭老鼠。
examples.en: He ruined them, and now he comes to comfort them; those are crocodile tears.

examples.zh: 别信那猫哭老鼠似的眼泪。
examples.en: Don't trust those crocodile tears.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。

text: 秃子头上的虱子——明摆着
pinyin: tū zi tóu shàng de shī zi —— míng bǎi zhe
variants: 和尚头上的虱子——明摆着
literal: bald person · head · on · 's · louse — plainly · displayed
natural: a louse on a bald head

meaning.en: A louse on a bald head can't hide; something plain for all to see.
meaning.zh: 秃子头上的虱子藏不住；比喻事情明显，一看便知。

equivalents: plain as the nose on your face

examples.zh: 谁对谁错，秃子头上的虱子，明摆着的事。
examples.en: Who's right and who's wrong is as plain as day.

examples.zh: 这是秃子头上的虱子，还用说吗？
examples.en: It's obvious; need we say more?

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous. The first half is often shortened to 和尚头上的虱子.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。前半句也常说成“和尚头上的虱子”。

text: 黄泥巴掉进裤裆里——不是屎也是屎
pinyin: huáng ní ba diào jìn kù dāng lǐ —— bù shì shǐ yě shì shǐ
literal: yellow · mud · fall into · trouser crotch · inside — not · be · dung · also · be · dung
natural: mud in one's trousers looks like dung either way

meaning.en: Mud falling into one's trousers looks like excrement whatever the truth; once suspected, it's hard to clear one's name.
meaning.zh: 黄泥巴掉进裤裆，说不清楚；比喻有口难辩，越解释越说不清。

examples.zh: 这事我解释不清，黄泥巴掉进裤裆里。
examples.en: I can't explain this away; mud sticks.

examples.zh: 他被人撞见了，真是黄泥巴掉进裤裆里。
examples.en: He was caught in the wrong place and can't prove his innocence.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous. Vulgar: avoid in formal or polite company.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。较粗俗，正式或客气场合不宜用。

text: 十五个吊桶打水——七上八下
pinyin: shí wǔ gè diào tǒng dǎ shuǐ —— qī shàng bā xià
literal: fifteen · bucket · draw · water — seven · up · eight · down
natural: fifteen buckets at the well: seven up, eight down

meaning.en: Fifteen buckets drawing water, seven rising and eight falling at once; a mind in turmoil, restless with worry.
meaning.zh: 十五个吊桶打水，七个上来八个下去；形容心里忐忑不安。

examples.zh: 等面试结果的时候，我心里十五个吊桶打水。
examples.en: While waiting for the interview result my heart was in my mouth.

examples.zh: 他听说要裁员，心里十五个吊桶打水，七上八下。
examples.en: Hearing about layoffs, he was on edge.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous. Also used as the shorter 七上八下. Seven plus eight makes fifteen.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。后半句也独立使用，“七上八下”。七加八正好十五。
